Async by itself does not make independent operations run concurrently — it only avoids blocking a thread while waiting on one. Achieving actual concurrency requires explicitly running multiple futures together, e.g., with
let (a, b, c) = tokio::join!(fetch(1), fetch(2), fetch(3));
